topic: From Circles to Heat: The Magic of Fourier Series

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Circular Motion Foundation
lecture_lines: Periodic functions are sums of rotating vectors.
These combined rotations create complex shapes.
animations: Display a circle in #FFFFFF, labeled 'Unit Circle'.
Animate a vector rotating, labeled 'Euler Vector' in #FF00FF.
Fade in projected sine wave in #00FFFF, labeled 'Projection'.

sections.title: Fourier Series: Decomposing the Wave
lecture_lines: Fourier series acts as a musical chord.
Complex signals contain many pure frequencies.
We sum sine waves of varying amplitudes.
animations: Display a complex wave in #FFFFFF, labeled 'Signal' next to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/guitar.svg].
Animate the components summing to match the signal, represented by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/guitar.svg] sound profile.

sections.title: Connecting to the Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The heat equation describes energy dispersal.
Sine waves remain stable as they decay.
Fourier components solve heat distribution problems.
animations: Display a heat bar [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bar.svg] in #FFFFFF, colored by temperature.
Animate the bar [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bar.svg] colors blending smoothly.
Highlight the Laplacian operator in #FFFF00 on the bar [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bar.svg].

sections.title: Visual Synthesis and Application
lecture_lines: Decompose a jagged temperature spike into waves.
Each individual wave component decays over time.
Summing these waves reconstructs smooth heat curves.
animations: Display a sharp spike in #FFFFFF, labeled 'Spike' next to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Animate sine waves decomposing the spike in #FF00FF.
Show sum of waves forming the smooth heat curve, represented by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
